lines.text: God tells Aaron to bring the Levites to assist him, but they must not come near the furnishings or the altar.
God gives the Levites as a gift to Aaron, and only Aaron and his sons serve inside the veil.
Firstborn sons must be redeemed for five shekels of gold, but the firstborn of an ox, a sheep, or a goat are not redeemed.
God tells Aaron he will have no land inheritance, and gives the Levites all the firstfruits in Israel as their inheritance.
The LORD tells Moses that the Levites must present a tithe of the tithe and give it to Aaron the priest.
